scope: Descriptive reconstruction from trial0 saved curve maxima, with all recorded trials and methods checked. Added after review; not a newly preregistered result or a new measurement.

primary_best_regret_reconstructed.quantity_checked: best_grid_winner_regret and its original counts/maxima only

definitions.grid_winners: i with grid maximum[i] >= max(grid maximum) - frozen winner_atol; includes tolerance-based near ties
definitions.distinct_winners: i with observed-distinct maximum[i] >= max(observed-distinct maximum) - frozen winner_atol
definitions.best_grid_winner_regret: max_i distinct[i] - max_{i in grid winners} distinct[i]
definitions.worst_grid_winner_regret: max_i distinct[i] - min_{i in grid winners} distinct[i]
definitions.threshold_scope: Strict score > threshold over observed score thresholds; excludes the below-minimum/all-positive state.

limits: Archive-only consistency, not an independent raw-data metric recomputation. No confidence interval, population interpretation or practical-benefit hypothesis is added. Semantic settings and recordings are dependent; no post-hoc case selection or replacement is performed.
